newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to privatise Zaporizha aluminium plant.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to privatise Zaporizha aluminium plant.

text.p: The Ukrainian government is planning to privatise its sole aluminium smelter and to sell one quarter of it to foreign investors, a senior official at the Zaporizha aluminium combine told Reuters late on Wednesday.

Ivan Sova, deputy chief executive in charge of economic affairs, said the plan was to sell at least 26 percent of the plant to a strategic foreign investor, and the sale of an additional 20 percent stake was also under consideration.
"We are waiting for a final decision from the cabinet," Sova said by telephone from Zaporizha.
The government, the Industry Ministry and the State Property Fund are still discussing how to distribute shares in the smelter on the Dnepr river in central Ukraine, he said.
The process is also being held up by a parliament vote on November 22 to suspend privatisation of medium-sized and large enterprises until proper rules are set up and corruption cut out.
Sova said staff and company management were insisting on a 16 percent share, while the government share would be no less than 26 percent but might be as much as 51 percent.
The State Property Fund has set the authorised capital of Zaporizhskiy Alyuminovy Kombinatat 155.6 million hryvnias ($82.7 million).
Zaporizha has an annual output capacity of 100,000 tonnes of aluminium. No official figures are available for output this year but it fell to 95,100 tonnes in 1995 from 98,100 in 1996.
Interfax-Ukraine news agency said the plant was currently working at 88 percent of capacity.
More than 80 percent of the plant's output goes to Russia, Belarus, Italy, Japan and other countries, earning $122.7 million in the first nine months of the year.
A state-guaranteed deal was signed with Italy's FATA in 1993 to build a factory capable of producing 25,000 tonnes of aluminium foil a year.
But production, planned for 1998, has been postponed due to a lack of funds and building works have not been completed.

Zaporizha is one of 208 enterprises designated by the government for strategic investment tenders in an effort to attract foreign investment, which has reached only $1.2 billion since independence five years ago.
